data.description: The noxious vapors and foul fluids that constantly weep and seethe from a hezrou's body are particularly heinous to those the creature grapples. Each round a creature is grappled by a hezrou, the grappled foe must make a DC %1 Fortitude save to avoid becoming nauseated. A creature nauseated in this manner remains nauseated until he succeeds on a DC %1 Fortitude save, or until a minute has passed during which he is not grappled by the hezrou, whichever condition comes first.
data.name: Nausea
